stories.title: Source: Pats' Rhamondre Stevenson expected to miss time with knee tendon issue
stories.summary: Patriots top running back Rhamondre Stevenson is dealing with a knee tendon issue that is not expected to require surgery but could sideline him for a short period of time, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.
stories.detail: FOXBOROUGH, Mass. -- New England Patriots top running back Rhamondre Stevenson is dealing with a knee tendon issue that is not expected to require surgery but could sideline him for a short period of time, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter. The injury is to the back of Stevenson's knee and is expected to keep him out the next few weeks, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. Stevenson sustained the injury late in the third quarter of the Patriots' blowout loss to the Green Bay Packers on Sunday, when he was twisted down on a 6-yard reception. The Patriots trailed 42-14 at the time. With No. 2 running back TreVeyon Henderson missing the past two games because of an illness, the Patriots could be down to their third and fourth options -- Corey Kiner and Lan Larison , respectively -- for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions in Munich. New England also has running back Terrell Jennings on the practice squad. The 5-4 Patriots are scheduled to travel to Munich late Wednesday and then have their bye week after the game. stories.detail: So much for Carson Wentz stealing Kyler Murray's job. The Vikings offense looks a lot like it has most of the season. stories.title: The Rams need Matthew Stafford to play like an MVP
stories.summary: The Rams need Matthew Stafford more than ever. Will he deliver?
stories.detail: The Los Angeles Rams are 5-4 and still in the NFC playoff picture, but the version of Matthew Stafford they have gotten through nine weeks is not the one that carried them last season. Stafford currently has 16 touchdowns and nine interceptions with a 90.6 passer rating. That is functional. It’s nowhere near “MVP” level. Last year Stafford was manufacturing big-time throws and taking care of the football. He has always been prone to mistakes. But this year has reached a higher frequency and there is less of the good to offset. The gap is evident in the efficiency metrics that separate good from elite. Stafford’s big-time throw rate has cratered from 7.7% to roughly 3% this year. His Pro Football Focus (PFF) offensive grade sits in the upper 60’s, good for no better than 20th among qualified quarterbacks. That is not the profile of a player who is elevating the offense around him. It’s the mark of someone who is mostly managing a system, if not part of the problem. The distinction matters because the supporting cast has not been built to absorb a decline in quarterback play. The Rams spent all offseason retooling their defense. The tradeoff brought minimal reinforcements on offense…

stories.title: Could the Jordan Davis trade suggest Eagles are preparing for a new defensive coordinator?
stories.summary: Reactions to the Jordan Davis trade are generally positive for the Eagles, and could also be pointing at even bigger changes.
stories.detail: Photo by Mitchell Leff/Getty Images | Getty Images The general consensus is that Howie Roseman won yet another trade, this time managing to get a first and second round pick from the Jaguars for Jordan Davis . As the team racks up draft capital over the next three years , another question is emerging from Davis being traded — could this move imply a new regime for the defense? Specifically, could the move indicate there’s potential for Jim Schwartz to return to Philly? According to Eagles beat reporter Jeff McLane , the team had privately reached out to Jim Schwartz earlier in the year when DC Vic Fangio was contemplating retirement. Moving on from Davis could indicate Fangio is once again considering walking away, and Schwartz’s scheme and personnel needs may already be impacting the Eagles’ roster-building decisions. Even former Eagles legend Brandon Graham spoke about the possibility of Schwartz returning to Philly on the PHLY post-game show — right next to BGN’s Brandon Lee Gowton —, saying that they have the guys his former DC would be able to maximize. stories.title: A 'confident' C.J. Stroud soaks in five-TD day against Chargers
stories.summary: Stroud matched his career high with five TD passes and added 384 passing yards in the win.
stories.detail: HOUSTON -- C.J. Stroud 's five-touchdown performance against the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday punctuated a hot start for the Houston Texans ' quarterback. Stroud & Co. were dominant in their 44-22 win , as he tied a career high in passing touchdowns to go with 384 yards passing, tied for his second most in a game. Stroud promised himself to "enjoy" his Week 9 performance rather than immediately moving on. "I beat myself up a lot when I don't do great, so I'm going to enjoy this and celebrate with my friends, family and teammates because I know what it feels like to throw a couple interceptions," Stroud said. "So, you need to be positive towards yourself. Something that playing the quarterback position has taught me about life is that everyone could view you one way, but all that matters is how God views you and how you view yourself, so I'm grateful that God has allowed me to have some tough skin and be able to push through some tough times. "Days like this come from being on the other side when you're not playing so great." The Texans' 3-5 record isn't because of poor quarterback play. teamStories.summary: The Seahawks plan to start quarterback Drew Lock on Sunday against the Raiders, giving Sam Darnold more time to recover from his injuries.
teamStories.detail: SEATTLE -- Quarterback Drew Lock 's stint as the Seattle Seahawks ' fill-in starter will last at least another week, coach Mike Macdonald said Monday. Macdonald told Seattle Sports 710-AM that the team got positive news on the oblique injury Lock suffered Sunday while quarterbacking the Seahawks to a 17-3 win over the Arizona Cardinals . Lock was starting in place of Sam Darnold , who was sidelined with quad and rib injuries. The Seahawks (5-4) play the Raiders in Las Vegas this coming Sunday before their bye in Week 11. "Good exam for Drew," Macdonald said in Monday's interview. "He's dealing with an oblique. I think it's something we can manage and [have] him play in the game," Macdonald said. "Sam will be another week. So it'll be a similar plan to last week." Darnold suffered a cracked rib on the second play of Seattle's loss to the Chicago Bears last Monday night, then injured his quad near the end of the game. The Seahawks did not place him on injured reserve, and Macdonald has described his status as week-to-week. Darnold did not practice leading up to the Arizona game. Macdonald said in his afternoon news conference that it looks like Darnold might return after the Week 11…

stories.title: Luka Doncic returns for Lakers; Austin Reaves, Quentin Grimes out vs. Hawks
stories.summary: Luka Doncic returned for the Lakers on Monday at Atlanta, but the team was without Austin Reaves (illness) and Quentin Grimes (sprained finger).
stories.detail: ATLANTA -- The Los Angeles Lakers got Luka Doncic back in the lineup Monday against the Atlanta Hawks but were not at full strength with Austin Reaves (illness) and Quentin Grimes (sprained finger on right hand) both out. Despite being short-handed, the Lakers beat the Hawks 124-114 to improve to 10-2. They are on a six-game winning streak. Reaves scored a season-high 43 points in Sunday's 121-116 win over the Detroit Pistons while Doncic was sidelined because of lower back tightness. Doncic finished with 32 points Monday after scoring 40-plus in four straight games. He leads the league with a 40.1 points-per-game average. Lakers coach JJ Redick said that with Reaves and Grimes sidelined, he planned to give early rotation minutes to rookie Cameron Carr , L.A.'s first-round pick.

stories.title: Jerome scores 27 points as Grizzlies improve to 5-0 on road by routing short-handed Raptors 118-102
stories.summary: — Ty Jerome scored 27 points, Cameron Boozer added 22 and the Memphis Grizzlies improved to 5-0 on the road this season by beating the short-handed Toronto Raptors 118-102 on Monday night.
stories.detail: TORONTO -- — Ty Jerome scored 27 points, Cameron Boozer added 22 and the Memphis Grizzlies improved to 5-0 on the road this season by beating the short-handed Toronto Raptors 118-102 on Monday night. Memphis is the only NBA team without a road loss this season. They’ve also won at Golden State, Sacramento, Utah and Portland. Jerami Grant scored 17 points and Jaylen Wells had 14 as the Grizzlies snapped a three-game losing streak and won for the fifth time in six trips to Toronto. Boozer had eight rebounds and eight assists. Zach Edey had eight points and nine rebounds in his lone regular-season visit to his hometown. Memphis was without center Isaiah Stewart (right knee) for the second straight game. Grizzlies center Quinten Post left in the first quarter after being elbowed in the face while defending Jamison Battle’s drive to the basket. Jamal Shead had 20 points and 11 assists for the Raptors, who played without three starters. Kawhi Leonard (left knee) missed his sixth straight game, while Scottie Barnes (left groin) and Immanuel Quickley (right hamstring) each sat for the second straight. Walker Kessler had 21 points and 10 rebounds, and Collin Sexton had 18 points and six assists off the bench. The Lakers were without guard Austin Reeves, who missed the game due to illness one day after scoring 43 points at Detroit. Sandro Mamukelashvili scored 23 points and was 5 of 8 from 3-point range. The Lakers as a team shot 43% from beyond the arc (15 of 35). CJ McCollum led the Hawks with 21 points off the bench. Dyson Daniels was the primary defender on Doncic, and he also had 10 points, eight assists, four steals and a rare 3-pointer.
